item.description: Each Item's panel keeps its label, record, threads and forms; its code button shows the lines it accounts for, +added −deleted, and its code is a placeholder.
item.label: Review page carries no diffs

item.description: Opening an Item fetches its diffs and fills the placeholder; Show more fetches the next page in place. Fetched pages are forgotten when the page is swapped.
item.label: The drawer fetches on open

item.description: Resolves the review's range and renders only the requested Item's references, from the review templates.
item.label: One Item's diffs

item.body: You would expect an Item to show all its code at once; a page stops at 25 references or 1,500 lines, and one diff at 400 lines. The Code Diff tab still shows whole files.
item.description: Why an Item with thousands of references stays fast to open.
item.label: Big Items arrive in pages

item.description: The page renders no diffs, the endpoint serves them and 404s unknown Items, pages follow Show more, and a long diff is cut.
item.label: Page, paging and cap tests

slide.takeaway: The review page carries panels but no diffs; an Item's code arrives from its own endpoint, a page at a time, when a reviewer opens it.
slide.title: Diffs load when an Item opens
